author: Microsoft
description:
Discover how Founderz is reimagining education and upskilling through AI-powered learning experiences, and how Microsoft technologies, including Azure, support their growth, innovation, and impact.

Founderz is training learners, professionals, and organizations to develop critical AI, digital, and innovation skills, while making education more accessible, scalable, and future-ready. Through this collaboration with Microsoft, Founderz leverages AI and cloud technologies to enhance learning experiences and performance.
